title: Trial by Farmer Music Pack (Reactive)
description: Music pack for the Trial by Farmer modpack
body:
This ReactiveMusic pack is intended for use with the [Trial by Farmer](https://modrinth.com/modpack/trial-by-farmer) modpack (but still sounds great with vanilla Minecraft). It enhances the fantasy experience with additional tracks by the same artists featured in the default ReactiveMusic pack, and adds tracks exclusive to Trial by Farmer! It also adds music to the Paradise Lost and Deep Underground dimensions, so if you have these mods in a different pack the music will play there too. 

Per-track music credits can be found in the musicsources.txt file in the zip.

Music by Adrian Von Ziegler, CO.AG Music, Myuu, and Vindsvept.

Tracks by bluestarunderscore (me):
- TBF_Menu
- AsAbove (plays in the Deep Underground)
- AsAbove_Stronghold (plays in the Deep Underground)
- ClearNight
- GlowSquids (plays in the Deep Underground)
- Unearthed (plays in the Deep Underground)
- Sunrise
- Sunset
  
AI was not used to create these tracks.
